breach.summary: Aflac disclosed a massive data breach affecting 22.65 million customers and employees. Threat actors gained unauthorized access to personal, medical, and health insurance data including Social Security numbers, dates of birth, and driver's license numbers.

UnitedHealth Group subsidiary Change Healthcare suffered a devastating ransomware attack affecting over 100 million healthcare records. The attack disrupted medical claims processing and pharmacy operations across the entire US healthcare system.
T-Mobile disclosed unauthorized access to customer data through an API vulnerability that exposed personal information for approximately 37 million customers.
The zero-day vulnerability CVE-2024-4577 in Progress MOVEit Transfer was exploited for mass data exfiltration campaigns by the Clop ransomware gang.
Video hosting platform Vimeo confirmed a data breach where threat actors accessed user and customer data.
Figure Technologies, a blockchain lending platform, suffered a data breach affecting approximately 967,000 user records.
FirstCare Health Plans exposed healthcare member data through an unsecured database.
Facial recognition company Clearview AI suffered a security breach compromising law enforcement agency credentials.
A catastrophic breach of National Public Data exposed personal information for nearly every US adult.
Frost Bank customers were targeted by ransomware gang claiming to have exfiltrated sensitive customer data.

cve.summary: Cisco IOS XE software contains an authentication bypass vulnerability in the web management interface.
JetBrains TeamCity CI/CD platform contains a pre-authentication remote code execution vulnerability.
SonicWall Secure Mobile Access (SMA) 1000 appliances contain path traversal and RCE vulnerabilities.
Windows IKE contains a critical remote code execution vulnerability.
Windows Shell contains a zero-click NTLM hash leak vulnerability.
cPanel & WHM contains a critical authentication bypass vulnerability.
GitHub Enterprise Server is vulnerable to remote code execution.
FortiClient Enterprise Management Server contains an improper access control vulnerability.
Apache OFBiz contains a Java deserialization remote code execution vulnerability.
Linux Kernel contains a privilege escalation vulnerability in the netfilter subsystem.

threat.summary: Russian military intelligence APT28 is actively exploiting CVE-2026-32202 Windows Shell vulnerability in coordinated campaigns.
North Korean state-sponsored Lazarus Group has stolen cryptocurrency through targeted attacks on exchanges.
Scattered Spider specializes in sophisticated social engineering attacks to compromise Fortune 500 companies.
LockBit is the largest ransomware group by revenue, operating a Ransomware-as-a-Service platform.
Clop ransomware gang exploited CVE-2024-4577 in MOVEit Transfer software.
BlackMatter emerged as successor to Darkside, responsible for the Colonial Pipeline attack.
FIN7 is responsible for an estimated $1+ billion USD in financial fraud and theft.
Chinese state-sponsored APT41 blends cybercriminal and espionage operations.
Wizard Spider operates and maintains the TrickBot banking malware platform.
Hive0163 is deploying Slopoly backdoor malware in targeted attacks.
